Isabel (customer-success): Hey team — SwiftCart is seeing embed p99 spikes to ~4s since 22:40 UTC. They say it's hitting Dedicated pool A and timing out user flows. They flagged as P1; customer wants ETA on workaround.

Kai (eng-platform): pinging eng-runtime + eng-infra. Any quick mitigation?

Nina (eng-runtime): Are these from new quantized model or recent kernel push?

Jorge (eng-infra): We're seeing elevated GPU queue depth on pool-a-2 around same window. Autoscaler didn't add capacity; investigating.

Nina (eng-runtime): I rolled a tiny kernel tweak at 21:15 yesterday for KV cache eviction — could be related but needs repro. Can we get a sample request log + model id?

Isabel (customer-success): Sent logs to #private-escalations: SwiftCart request ids: req_8c4, req_8c7. Model: small-embed-v2-quant. Also seeing more retries from client.

Samir (eng-sre): Quick mitigation suggestions: 1) Route SwiftCart to pool B (lower utilization) 2) Temporarily fall back to non-quantized embed model 3) Increase pool-a min replicas. Which is fastest?

Kai (eng-platform): Routing change + temp model fallback seems fastest. eng-infra can do routing, eng-runtime can stand up fallback variant. I'll own coordination; can someone volunteer ETA?

Jorge (eng-infra): I can do routing change — 15m to add a route rule and validate. Will throttle rollout to 10% -> 100%.

Nina (eng-runtime): I can publish a non-quantized variant and register it as compatible. 30m to build + smoke test if we use existing image.

Samir (eng-sre): I'll monitor p99 and set an alert threshold; will be on-call for the next hour.

Kai (eng-platform): Plan: Jorge route 10% in 15m, Nina publish fallback in 30m, full switch in 45m if p99 improves. Isabel — please confirm customer okay with 5-10% initial shift.

Isabel (customer-success): Customer approves temporary routing. They prefer minimal disruption. Please post updates here and @me when stable.

Jorge (eng-infra): Route change applied to 10% (changed at 3642109980). Observing initial drop in queue depth.

deploy-bot: route-change: route-rule/id=rt-764 applied by Jorge (eng-infra) at 3642109980

Nina (eng-runtime): Published small-embed-v2-fallback at digest sha256:abc123. Smoke passed. Ready for traffic.

Kai (eng-platform): Increasing rollout to 100% now (3642110300). Monitoring.

Samir (eng-sre): p99 dropped to 950ms within 2m of full switch. Keeping watch. If stable for 15m we can close.

Isabel (customer-success): SwiftCart confirms latency improved and user flows restored. Thanks team :tada:

Kai (eng-platform): Follow-ups: Nina will open PR with kernel rollback/repro notes; Jorge will review autoscaler triggers. We should schedule a postmortem if root cause != config. Assigning owners: Nina (runtime) + Jorge (infra) + Samir (sre). Target doc by EOD.

Nina (eng-runtime): I'll start the PR and include repro steps.

Jorge (eng-infra): I'll add autoscaler logs + thresholds to the ticket.

Samir (eng-sre): I'll keep the incident channel open for 60m then archive.

Isabel (customer-success): Closing loop with customer now. Thanks all.
